recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, sepia-toned urban portrait featuring two male figures in sunglasses, framed by a decorative spiral border and centered ornate, calligraphic typography with extensive flourishes.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical balance between two seated figures
Contrast between gritty photographic texture and clean vector flourishes
Depth created by figures in the foreground against a patterned wallpaper background
Framing provided by a continuous geometric spiral border
coreInvariants: Dark sepia or deep chocolate brown monochrome palette
Heavy use of calligraphic swashes and filigree
Geometric border framing the entire composition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male figures seated, occupying the middle third of the frame, scaled to appear life-sized within the context.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, ornate central lettering with white outlines.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top metadata text, moves down to the subjects' faces, then flows through the central logo-like text to the bottom name.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured areas around the subjects and within the border margins.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm cream or off-white (highlights and text outlines)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted terracotta (border and secondary text background)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast between dark shadows and bright highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy vertical strokes with sharp, thorn-like serifs
Extensive, symmetrical swashes extending from terminals
Double-line outlines to separate text from dark background
Interlocking characters in the primary name block
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature internal decorative voids
Descenders transform into long, curling filigree
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate, custom display lettering paired with a clean, high-contrast serif for readability.
graphicDevices: Rounded rectangular pill shape for secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base blackletter skeleton for modification
Matches the high-contrast serif metadata text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast sepia-toned photograph of two men in sunglasses and dark shirts sitting in an ornate room with patterned wallpaper. Frame the image with a terracotta-colored spiral geometric border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, custom blackletter-style text in the center foreground with white double-outlines and extensive calligraphic flourishes. Place secondary metadata text in a clean serif font at the top and within a pill-shaped box in the center.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic brown/sepia?
Are the swashes on the main text symmetrical and ornate?
Does the border consist of a repeating spiral motif?
Is the lighting on the subjects high-contrast?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text outlines are crisp and white
Verify the border is continuous and geometric
Check that the sepia tone is consistent across the image
Confirm the subjects are wearing sunglasses as a key stylistic element
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Sepia Duotone + Baroque Filigree Lettering + Geometric Spiral Border
